review.tagline: Persistent cross-session memory for coding agents via hooks, MCP and REST
review.summary: agentmemory captures what coding agents do through hooks, compresses it into searchable memory, and injects relevant context at the start of later sessions. It runs a local server on a pinned iii engine with no external database, exposes 54 MCP tools plus a REST API, and shares one store across Claude Code, Cursor, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI and others. Keyless mode uses BM25; embeddings are optional.
review.audience: Developers using coding agents who want memory kept across sessions and tools
strengths: No external database; state lives in a local data directory
One server shared by 20 listed agents via hooks, MCP or REST
Keyless BM25 mode works offline; local embeddings use Xenova/all-MiniLM-L6-v2
weaknesses: Keyless mode has no vector embeddings, so semantic queries can return nothing
Pins iii-engine v0.22.1 and will not attach to a different engine version
Native Windows needs a manual iii.exe install; WSL2 or Docker is the easier path
needs: Models: Xenova/all-MiniLM-L6-v2 (local embeddings), optional LLM provider for compression
